visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair, glasses, and a white cat-ear headband stands indoors. She wears an oversized black graphic t-shirt and holds a printout of a cartoonish pink rabbit. The background features a rustic wooden wall and artificial white floral decorations hanging from above. (2) The scene transitions to the same woman outdoors in an elaborate cosplay outfit. She has shoulder-length pink hair with yellow highlights, white cat ears, and a frilly blue and mint-green dress with a yellow chick accessory. She stands on a wooden bridge surrounded by green bushes and purple hydrangea flowers under bright natural sunlight. (3) The woman begins a rhythmic dance, moving her arms and body in sync with a fast tempo. She performs various hand gestures, including heart shapes and pointing, while holding a large blue paw-shaped prop. The camera maintains a medium shot, capturing her energetic facial expressions and movements. (4) The video concludes with a stylized static graphic. The cosplayer is posed in the foreground against a vibrant blue background featuring a large, smiling cartoon cat/slime character. Chinese text is overlaid across the bottom of the frame.
